Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
Hello.

Allow me to introduce the new Net.Rep: me.

Note the new e-mail address. Please do not
use my old e-mail address for official (WotC)
queries.

I'll post a few answers to posts that have been
pending for a while shortly.

In the meantime, any questions? :-)

--
L. Scott Johnson (vte...@regency.wizards.com)
Official VtES Net.Rep for Wizards of the Coast.
(*) - Subject to review by Rules Team

Messages.Author: Joshua Duffin
Messages.Body:
L. Scott Johnson (vte...@wizards.com) wrote:

: use my old e-mail address for official (WotC)
: queries.

: I'll post a few answers to posts that have been
: pending for a while shortly.

: In the meantime, any questions? :-)

Hey, congratulations! Wow, a real live netrep, it's been a while. So,
now that I have an empowered audience, is there any chance that Reform Body
will be errataed to be playable by a vampire in torpor? I'd really like to
see that, though of course there is not yet any precedent for reactions
playable from torpor.

The reaction-part of the card is almost unusable now, though - the only
case I can think of where it could be played as a reaction (rather than a
combat card) is if a successful Sacrifice were called on the vamp.

So congratulations again - I'm sure it'll be nice to have a rep who's
actually "one of us."

Josh

Messages.Author: Charles Keith-Stanley
Messages.Body:
In article <5esr57$5...@news.wizards.com>, vte...@wizards.com (L. Scott
Johnson) wrote:

> Hello.
>
> Allow me to introduce the new Net.Rep: me.

And allow *me* to apologize for the length of time needed to bring LSJ on
board. The single longest delay was the time needed to get him an account
on our Regency system, since the same overworked folks in our Computing
Resources department who handle such accounts also have to deal with all
our in-house problems. Funny, that; their manager seems to think WotC's
computer problems ought to come first...

Anyway, I'm glad to be able to add LSJ to our coterie of Network
Representatives, and urge you to welcome him as the "official" voice of
Wizards of the Coast for .jyhad and the VTES-L mailing list.

--
Charles Keith-Stanley were...@wizards.com
Cyberspace Coordinator lia...@wizards.com
Wizards of the Coast, Inc. http://www.wizards.com

Congratulation on netrep-hood! I'm glad that we can now "get over" some
of the bad rulings issued just before "the Great Silence" (in particular,
the hand-strike ruling). So I take it you will be toeing the "Rules Team
Line" in your rep role, even when you don't cotton to some rulings? As
I remember it, you weren't particularly enamored of the "Blood to Water
only usable at close range" errata. I was just wondering how much influence
your feedback has with the RT. Do the rulings you mark with a '*' actually
get discussed at RT meetings? (Are there RT meetings anymore???)

--Eric
